title: build_inspector reds a proof that moves HOME around the scratch door: scratch_home_goes_through_the_door
intention: No proof moves HOME around the scratch door unseen: the build inspector reds the row that holds it at its own crossing.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i at main: the two scans (scratch_home_bypass, and scratch_home_in_process from 4fb37aa5a13f) name 20 sites in 12 components: 18 hand-built child envs and 2 in-process moves, which the home_env switches in flight (8e0c, 2270, 35bb, dbe7, a9c9, ca51, cc68, 01414c39eb2b, a0f74572040b) are cast to clear. Today a component holds its own proofs to the door with its own tooth; a proof written tomorrow in a component without one would bypass unseen. The orchestrator asked for the sieve once the count is 0, design boundary CC's.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics); Law 8.
how: D1: inspector.py gains scratch_home_goes_through_the_door(row, comp_dir): one finding per site either scan names under comp_dir, expected 0 actual 1, site and scan in values; a site under a nested dir that carries its own charter is skipped, since it answers at its own row. Registered in SIEVES. D2: sieves/scratch_home_goes_through_the_door.json: band 1 record, why + why_source {kind: cc_reading, of: d95796cdfb9b} (outline 17.11.6.2). D3: new proof test_scratch_home_goes_through_the_door.py: four fixture teeth and the live-corpus invariant (zero sites over every chartered dir, denominator > 50, a control that must red first).

clauses.claim: a row whose proof hand-builds a scratch-HOME child env reds, naming the site
a row whose proof moves HOME in-process and leaves USERPROFILE reds, naming the site
a row whose proofs go through home_env or move both keys is quiet; a held component's offending proof reds at its own row and not its holder's
the sieve sits in SIEVES and its record carries a why sourced as CC's reading of d95796cdfb9b
over every component under cairn/, zero sites
